name: Cloudinary
description: Cloudinary lets agents search, upload, tag and organize images, videos and files, and build transformation URLs. Each user signs in to their own Cloudinary account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find the product images tagged summer in my Cloudinary account.
Upload this image to the marketing folder.
Give me a URL for this image resized to 800 pixels wide.

apps.name: Cloudinary
apps.description: Asset search, upload, tagging, and folders, over Cloudinary's MCP server with browser sign-in.
